approved_differences.statement: No HTTP behavior difference is approved in this internal capability slice. Authentication, raw query parsing, creator-name enrichment, route-specific type normalization, presentation projection and safe errors remain future operations-owned parity requirements.

forbidden_in_this_slice: HTTP controller, security matcher, role decision or rate limiter
users or subjects join inside the catalog adapter
creator username lookup or row-driven identity calls
portable question format, Chinese label, tags or image projection inside catalog
route parity delta or OpenAPI operation migration

catalog_application_contract.runtime_sql: one of four explicit nine-column SELECT variants over questions with optional typed filters and fixed q.id DESC ordering

filters.name: subjectId
filters.present: bind the complete signed integer domain exactly, including zero and negative values

filters.name: questionType
filters.present: bind exact text without trimming, case folding, alias conversion or treating all specially

result_semantics.ordering: strict q.id DESC for every variant
result_semantics.cardinality: unbounded list matching the legacy collection fact; no hidden limit or pagination is introduced
result_semantics.signed_id: negative, zero and positive question IDs remain representable because the collection route has no integer path converter and the legacy schema has no nonnegative check
result_semantics.raw_text: type, content, tags and image path remain unparsed and unmodified
result_semantics.nullable_columns: all schema-compatible nullable legacy columns remain null
result_semantics.creator: createdBy is the raw questions.created_by ID; catalog never resolves a username
result_semantics.failure: the original persistence exception propagates unchanged so operations can apply the reviewed HTTP policy

shared_authentication.valid_administrator_bearer_only: 302 Location /login because the global admin Web gate does not accept Bearer-only access
shared_authentication.ordinary_session_plus_valid_administrato: 302 Location /login because the Bearer header bypasses the Web-session branch of the global gate

shared_query_semantics.subject_zero_or_negative: the raw first value is bound and can match
shared_query_semantics.subject_blank_or_out_of_range: the captured SQLite contract returns an empty list after one collection SELECT; future operations owns this raw-string edge
shared_query_semantics.ordering: strict id DESC including a captured negative question ID
shared_query_semantics.pagination: none; success is a naked JSON array

type_normalization.modern: any_type_to_portable_type maps Chinese choice, single_choice and single to single_choice; empty, uppercase ALL and unknown values map to essay
type_normalization.legacy: q_type_to_portable_type maps the Chinese choice label to single_choice but single_choice, single, empty, uppercase ALL and unknown values to essay
type_normalization.catalog_boundary: operations must pass the already reviewed database type as an exact optional filter; catalog performs no alias conversion

modern_projection.content: portable normalization trims or rewrites fill placeholders
modern_projection.tags: valid arrays become comma-joined strings, malformed text is retained, null becomes empty
modern_projection.image_path: non-array scalar text is wrapped as array JSON text and null or empty becomes []
modern_projection.creator: the legacy users join returns username as created_by; missing or orphan creators become null

legacy_projection.tags: valid arrays remain arrays, malformed text is retained, null remains null
legacy_projection.image_path: the same legacy JSON string normalization is applied
legacy_projection.creator: the legacy users join returns username as created_by; missing or orphan creators become null

failure_semantics.database_failure_accept_any: 500 fixed generic Chinese HTML error page after one attempted collection SELECT
failure_semantics.database_failure_accept_json: 500 generic safe JSON error envelope after one attempted collection SELECT

cross_cutting_effects.questions_fingerprint: all fifteen questions columns remain unchanged for every case
cross_cutting_effects.session_activity: Session-only requests can update users.last_active once before the collection handler; this identity effect is outside the catalog primitive and is separately ledgered
cross_cutting_effects.blocked_bearer_paths: anonymous, Bearer-only and Session-plus-Bearer redirect before any SQL in the captured cases
cross_cutting_effects.rate_limit: neither route declares a route-specific limit; future operations must preserve the applicable global policy rather than invent an endpoint limit

invariants: The catalog capability reads only the catalog-owned questions table and never joins users or subjects.
Every invocation executes exactly one fixed bound SELECT and no DML, DDL or TEMP operation.
All nine selected columns map to immutable raw summaries without dropping signed IDs, malformed text or nullable values.
Every result is strictly ordered by id descending, including zero and negative historical keys.
No HTTP authentication, raw query parsing, PQF mapping, creator username, Chinese label, image rewrite or response envelope enters catalog.
Persistence failures remain untranslated at the catalog boundary.
PostgreSQL 16.14 and 18.4 execute the same four adapter SQL variants.
Synthetic query-plan indexes are test-only observations and do not authorize a production migration or claim a production index.
Both HTTP operations remain operations-owned and pending; this capability changes no route, OpenAPI migration status or production traffic.

required_before_phase4h_route_migration: approve and machine-check operations dependencies on catalog and identity public APIs
implement the complete shared global-gate, role and users.last_active behavior
parse raw subject/type inputs and reproduce both route-specific type normalizers
resolve creator IDs in one bounded identity batch rather than one call per row
implement both distinct content/tags/image projections without changing raw catalog summaries
preserve the safe Accept-dependent error and global rate-limit policies
add route delta and OpenAPI migration only after all 50 golden cases pass
acceptance.next_phase4a_work: continue the next catalog-only read after this capability passes full isolated acceptance
